rejections.question: Which posts have the highest post-voting score?
rejections.sql: SELECT p.id AS post_id, t.title, SUM(pvv.direction) AS vote_score FROM post_voting_votes pvv JOIN posts p ON p.id=pvv.votable_id AND pvv.votable_type='Post' JOIN topics t ON t.id=p.topic_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, t.title ORDER BY vote_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.id LIMIT 20;
